reviews.text: I use their carrotene pad, mask and toner and it kinda give me natural glow somehow. but never try their foam one, so I jump it to buy the carotene but sadly it need to wait for instock so I got this one since I literally ran out of foam. but definitely will buy carrot foam soon.
reviews.zh: 我用緊佢哋嘅胡蘿蔔素化妝棉、面膜同化妝水，佢多少都令我有啲自然光澤。不過我未試過佢哋嘅泡沫產品，所以本來想買胡蘿蔔素嗰款，但可惜要等貨，而我嘅泡沫潔面產品啱啱用晒，所以就買咗呢款。一定好快會買胡蘿蔔泡沫。

reviews.text: I have an oily T-zone and this has helped minimise congestion and i reccomend using an oil cleanser alongside this to really clear out whiteheads and debris from the nose/enlarged pores! The texture is thick foam which lathers nicely using a pea sized amount, and the smell is clean and NOT eggy which is what i was concerned with before i purchased 😆
reviews.zh: 我 T 區油性，呢款有助減少毛孔阻塞。我建議同油類潔面產品一齊用，先真係可以清走鼻位嘅白頭粉刺同污垢，以及放大嘅毛孔！質地係厚身泡沫，用豌豆大小嘅份量就可以打出好多泡。香味乾淨，而且唔會有蛋味——呢點係我買之前最擔心嘅 😆

reviews.text: I only use this on days I do like a peel off mask to pull gunk out of my pores. Really helps to bring all the gunk to the surface so the mask can grip on them and pull them out. I could also see the gunk on the surface of my skin a little after using this on the places where my pores were clogged up, also bought this for a family member but they haven't used it yet
reviews.zh: 我只係喺做撕拉面膜、用嚟拉走毛孔污垢嗰日先用呢款。佢真係幫手將所有污垢逼返上面，等面膜容易黏住同拉走。我喺毛孔堵塞嘅位置用咗之後，亦都見到少少污垢喺皮膚表面。我仲買咗一支俾屋企人，但佢哋未用。

reviews.text: This really works wonders. Combo skin type and doesn't break me out. Really makes the skin so baby smooth. This is the only thing I use to clean my face as other products makes me break out. Definitely does make your pores smaller and I noticed also minimizes the chance of you getting blackheads
reviews.zh: 真係好神奇。我係混合皮膚，用咗都冇爆痘。令皮膚變得超級嫩滑。呢款係我唯一用嚟潔面嘅產品，因為其他產品用咗我都會爆痘。絕對可以令毛孔收細，我亦留意到會減少黑頭出現嘅機會。

reviews.text: This product is perfect if you have pores. It clean perfectly your skin. it feels like your skin is not oily at all after using it, but without feeling that it is dry. Sad that it is out of stock now, hope it will come back soon, cause that's a product i want to definitely buy again
reviews.zh: 如果你有毛孔問題，呢款產品好啱。佢可以好好咁清潔皮膚。用完之後皮膚感覺完全唔油，但又唔會覺得乾。可惜而家冇貨，希望佢快啲有貨，因為呢款係我一定想再買嘅產品。

reviews.text: I actually "threw" this product into my shopping cart here at the last minute... And oh I am so glad I did. After only a week of use I can see a huge improvement not only in the size of my pores (they are practically invisible), but also in the overall condition of my skin. Definitely going to repurchase, and will buy the whole line. Works like a charm on sensitive skin
reviews.zh: 我其實係最後一刻先「掉」咗呢款落購物車……我真係好慶幸嗰時咁做！只用咗一個星期，我已經見到好大改善，唔單止毛孔（幾乎睇唔到）收細咗，皮膚整體狀態都好咗。一定會再買，仲會買埋成個系列。對敏感皮膚效果好神奇。

reviews.text: I used to use this cleansing foam a few years ago and at the time when I had run out, I couldn't get another. I ended up buying other cleansers and using them and forgot about this one for a while. A few months ago I noticed my skin really wasn't looking as good as it had been before and I narrowed it down to my lax skincare routine. I have sensitive, combination skin with a moderately oily t-zone and large pores on my nose area. I'm pretty picky with scents/texture but I find this one quite nice. It has a light, refreshing and clean scent to it (I think of freshly applied lotion/fresh laundry on clean skin) and is of a pearly, medium-thick consistency. I remembered the compliments I received when I was using this cleanser in my routine and thankfully found it in stock again so hurried to buy it! I can honestly say that my skin feels and looks amazing since I have been using this again in my routine. I have also been using it with the A'Pieu Bubble Maker to get the right consistency before applying to my wet face and it has been great (a pea sized amount is all that you need). If I forget to use the bubble maker, I just try to make sure I lather it as much as I can in my hands before applying to my face. I find this makes a great difference in ensuring skin is squeaky clean! It has evened out my skin tone wonderfully, helped thoroughly clean and significantly reduce the size of my pores, my skin is so much clearer and brighter and I could not be happier to have this back in my life! I will continue to repurchase this lovely, skin saving product!
reviews.zh: 我幾年前用過呢款潔面泡沫，但當時用完，我買唔到第二支。我之後用咗其他潔面產品，就暫時忘記咗呢款。幾個月前，我發覺皮膚狀態好差，我歸咎於自己嘅護膚程序懶散。我係敏感、混合皮膚，T 區油性中等，鼻位毛孔大。我對香味同質地好挑剔，但我覺得呢款幾好。佢有一種輕盈、清新同潔淨嘅香味（我會聯想到剛搽咗乳液嘅感覺／乾淨皮膚上嘅洗衣香味），質地係珍珠光、中厚身嘅。我記得我用呢款潔面時收到嘅讚美，好彩喺貨架又有貨，所以即刻買咗！我可以老實講，自從再次將呢款加入護膚程序，我皮膚嘅感覺同樣子都好驚人。我都會同 A'Pieu Bubble Maker 一齊用，令泡沫質地啱啱好，先至搽喺濕面上，效果好好（一粒豌豆大小已經足夠）。如果我唔記得用泡泡器，我就會盡量喺手心搓出泡沫，然後先搽喺面上。我覺得咁樣確保皮膚清潔到好「吱吱聲」，好大分別！佢令我膚色更均勻，清潔得好徹底，明顯收細咗毛孔，皮膚更加清透、明亮，我真係好開心呢款產品返返嚟我嘅生活！我會繼續再買呢支令皮膚重生嘅好產品！

reviews.text: I found out about this brand and product on Twitter and decided to try it since the girl had the same issues as me (combination skin, tiny spots on the forehead) and she was raving about it. I am very glad I decided to try it since most of the forehead bumps are gone, my skin feels tighter and less oily and I am definitely having fewer breakouts. I also love the very mild smell and the feeling it leaves after using, like dry but not in a bad way as if it had removed all the ugly greasiness. I am repurchasing another one soon even though I still have half a bottle left, I don't want to run out of it and go back to how my skin was before.
reviews.zh: 我喺 Twitter 上面認識咗呢個品牌同呢款產品，因為有個女仔同我有同樣問題（混合皮膚、額頭有細粒斑點），而佢狂讚呢款，所以我決定試吓。我好慶幸試咗，因為額頭嗰啲凸起大部分都冇咗，皮膚感覺緊緻啲、冇咁油，而且爆痘明顯少咗。我都好鍾意佢好淡嘅香味，同用完之後嘅感覺——有啲乾，但係唔係壞嗰種乾，好似已經將嗰種難睇嘅油膩感去咗咁。我即將再買一支，即使而家仲有半支，因為我唔想用完，然後皮膚又變返之前嗰個樣。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
